unit_label: Section 5: Involutionsform und Involutionsbasis der Körper K_{n rho}
translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice; English control slice used only as a sanity witness for the older geometric vocabulary.

technical_exclusions.disposition: Section 6 and later content; not included in this checkpoint.

segment_summaries.content: Section heading: involution form and involution basis of fields K_{n rho}.
segment_summaries.choices: Involutionsform/Involutionsbasis use the introduction's involution lane: інволюційна форма/база, инволюционная форма/база, involucijska forma/baza.

segment_summaries.content: Contrasts arbitrary rational bases from Section 4 with a rational basis determined uniquely by the field.
segment_summaries.choices: Eindeutig bestimmt is rendered as однозначно визначена/однозначно определенная/jednoznačno opreděljena.

segment_summaries.content: Defines the involution form Phi* as the monic irreducible homogeneous form obtained from the algebraic element u(x).
segment_summaries.choices: German ganze Funktion is kept as ціла функція/целая функция/cěla funkcija, with modern algebraic polynomial sense logged for review.

segment_summaries.content: Shows the coefficients of Phi* form a rational basis by comparing extension degrees, then transfers the result to K_{n rho}.
segment_summaries.choices: Teilköper is explicit as підполе/подполе/podpolje; field identity follows from identity of degrees.

segment_summaries.content: Theorem III states that coefficients of the involution form form the field-determined rational basis, the involution basis.
segment_summaries.choices: Roman theorem number III remains Latin in all scripts; Cyrillic report confirms it is the only protected Latin word.

segment_summaries.content: Introduces an irrational/geometric interpretation tying the basis to the theory of involution.
segment_summaries.choices: Irrational is preserved as ірраціональне/иррациональное/iracionalno rather than replaced by algebraic.

segment_summaries.content: Factors Phi* in an extension field and identifies the coefficients with elementary symmetric functions of the rows of quantities.
segment_summaries.choices: Größenreihen is rendered as ряди величин/ряды величин/redy veličin, matching the English control's rows of quantities.

segment_summaries.content: Every field function f*=F*/H* gives infinitely many relations among conjugate rows.
segment_summaries.choices: The long equality is line-broken inside aligned math for page safety without changing tag (6).

segment_summaries.content: Conversely, a row xi satisfying the infinite relations belongs to the rows of quantities.
segment_summaries.choices: Nebenbedingung-style nonzero condition H*(xi) != 0 is displayed on its own aligned line for layout.

segment_summaries.content: Uses the common denominator G* to show xi is one of the conjugate rows; the definition is stable under replacing x by a conjugate row.
segment_summaries.choices: Gemeinsamer Nenner is common denominator/спільний знаменник/общий знаменатель/obči imenovatelj.

segment_summaries.content: Geometric interpretation: solutions form groups of i points in rho-dimensional linear space; these groups define an involution.
segment_summaries.choices: Fundamentalpunkte are фундаментальні точки/фундаментальные точки/fundamentalne točke; points at infinity are kept as quoted geometric language.

segment_summaries.content: A field K_{n rho} correspondingly characterizes an involution consisting of curves, surfaces, and so on.
segment_summaries.choices: Interslavic Latin abbreviates 'and so on' as 'itd.' to avoid Cyrillic transliterator's protected standalone bibliographic d.

segment_summaries.content: The degree i equals the number of solution systems satisfying the side condition, enabling an irrational formulation.
segment_summaries.choices: Lösungssysteme becomes systems of solutions in all lanes.

segment_summaries.content: If L* is a divisor of K* and all solution systems of L* are solution systems of K*, then L*=K*.
segment_summaries.choices: Teiler is deliberately rendered as divisor/dільник/делитель/dělitelj and flagged for review, not silently flattened to subfield.

segment_summaries.content: Transfer principle applies the corresponding statement to divisors L of K_{n rho}.
segment_summaries.choices: Principle of transfer continues the stable Section 3/4 terminology.

review_flags: Interslavic `involucijska forma` and `involucijska baza` should be checked against Jan/authority preference; introduction already fixed `involucijska baza`.
Interslavic `redy veličin` is a literal rows-of-quantities term; later Sections 8 and 14 reuse the same German phrase and should be kept consistent.
German `ganze Funktion` is translated in the older whole-function/polynomial sense; review whether a parenthetical polynomial note is desirable in a public edition.
German `Teiler` in the field statement is rendered as divisor in all languages following the English control; review against later polynomial-divisor terminology before final cumulative freeze.
Cyrillic reader is deterministic; Latin Interslavic remains source-of-truth.
